Cordovox browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Cordovox DS-9 Distortion Published on September 8, 2025 Cordovox distortion pedal Information The Cordovox DS-9 is a classic distortion pedal with a straightforward design, built for players who prefer simplicity and ease of use. With just two primary controls, LEVEL and DISTORTION, it allows quick adjustment from subtle grit to heavier, saturated tones. Its analog circuitry delivers a traditional distortion character, while German WIMA capacitors ensure clarity and low signal loss. The pedal is housed in a stainless steel enclosure with a mirror-polished finish for durability and a professional look. A true bypass footswitch with LED indicator preserves signal integrity when disengaged. Power is supplied by either a 9V battery or a 9V DC adapter.
